areas.title: Yerde vücut ağırlığı kuvveti
areas.existing_architecture: Existing pinned pose extractor → app movement JSON / rep, hold, multi-phase FSM and confidence/identity gates. Calibrate metric/phase/reference parameters on first-party clips; an optional identity/rejection classifier remains a separate research proposal, not a new backbone.
areas.next_operation: Human teaching demonstration and annotation → exact pinned extraction/DSP replay → reference/rule calibration candidate → heldout evaluation → real-device parity. No runtime promotion in this change.
areas.acceptance_gap: Physical teaching/rights/learner and device evidence open; no first-party capture supplied.
